list.name: adjudicante
list.label: Adjudicante
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, entity_id AS __value FROM procurement.entities_adjudicantes ORDER BY name

list.name: adjudicatario
list.label: Adjudicatário
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, entity_id AS __value FROM procurement.entities_adjudicatarios ORDER BY name

panels.title: Rows shown
panels.description: The table below is capped at LIMIT 5000 rows, newest first; this count makes a silent truncation visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_shown FROM (SELECT v.idcontrato FROM procurement.v_contracts_enriched v WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) LIMIT 5000) t

SELECT v.celebrated_at AS "Date", v.adjudicante_name AS "Adjudicante", a.adjudicatario_names AS "Adjudicatário(s)", v.objecto_contrato AS "Objecto", v.desc_contrato AS "Descrição", v.preco_contratual AS "Preço", v.tipo_contrato AS "Tipo", v.cpv AS "CPV", v.idcontrato AS "ID" FROM procurement.v_contracts_enriched v LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT string_agg(a2.adjudicatario_name, ', ' ORDER BY a2.adjudicatario_name) AS adjudicatario_names FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a2 WHERE a2.idcontrato = v.idcontrato) a ON true WHERE $__timeFilter(v.celebrated_at) AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a3 WHERE a3.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a3.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) ORDER BY v.celebrated_at DESC LIMIT 5000
